instruction: Set the screen to dim after 30 seconds of idle time in the power management settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the idle-delay from 300 seconds (5 minutes) to 30 seconds. Verified that gsettings outputs format 'uint32 30\n' for this value.
